options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: application_pcap_name
options.description: When I(category=application-pcap), this can be a blank string, a packet capture directory name, or a packet capture name.  If the value is either blank or a directory name, a list of directories or packet capture files will be returned.  If the value is a packet capture file name, the file will be written to I(filename).

options.name: category
options.description: Element type to export.

options.name: certificate_format
options.description: Format for the certificate.

options.name: certificate_include_keys
options.description: Whether to include the private key in the export.

options.name: certificate_name
options.description: Name of the certificate to export.

options.name: certificate_passphrase
options.description: Passphrase used to encrypt the certificate and/or private key.

options.name: create_directory
options.description: Whether to create directory when exporting.

options.name: dlp_password
options.description: Password used to decrypt DLP packet capture.

options.name: dlp_pcap_name
options.description: When I(category=dlp-pcap), this value can be a blank string, or a packet capture name.  If the value is blank, a list of packet capture files will be returned.  If the value is a packet capture file name, the file will be written to I(filename).

options.name: filename
options.description: Local path to output file (if any).

options.name: filter_pcap_name
options.description: When I(category=filter-pcap), this value can be a blank string, or a packet capture name.  If the value is blank, a list of packet capture files will be returned.  If the value is a packet capture file name, the file will be written to I(filename).

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: threat_pcap_id
options.description: When I(category=threat-pcap), this value is a unique identifier for the packet capture, and can be obtained from the 'pcap_id' field in the THREAT log.

options.name: threat_pcap_search_time
options.description: When I(category=threat-pcap), this value is is used to narrow the search for the 'pcap_id' and is used to set a time window in the range -5 minutes to +2 hours of the time specified. The search time is typically set to the **receive_time** field in the THREAT log. The PAN-OS log time string format is used, for example '2015/01/20 10:51:09'.  If the value is not specified, it will be set to the threat epoch time which is part of the 'pcap_id'.

options.name: threat_pcap_serial
options.description: When I(category=threat-pcap), this value is required when exporting from Panorama and is used to specify the device to fetch the packet capture from.

options.name: timeout
options.description: When category is set to 'tech-support', 'stats-dump', or 'device-state', the operating can take a while to complete.  This is the maximum amount of time to wait, in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.
